response.sql:
WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT r.name, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(res.points AS REAL), 0)) AS total_points
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), above_average_names AS (
  SELECT name, total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
  WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)
), selected_results AS (
  SELECT res.points, CAST(res.laps AS REAL) AS laps
  FROM above_average_names AS a
  JOIN races AS r ON r.name = a.name
  JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
)
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(CAST(points AS REAL), 0)) AS combined_total_points,
       AVG(laps) AS average_laps_completed,
       AVG(a.total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)) AS average_excess_over_average_total
FROM above_average_names AS a
JOIN races AS r ON r.name = a.name
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN selected_results AS sr ON sr.rowid = res.rowid

assumptions.assumption: Race-name totals sum results.points across all races sharing each name; the average is the unweighted average of those distinct race-name totals. Average laps is across result rows for races with above-average names.

alternatives.interpretation: Average laps and excess are averaged once per qualifying race name, rather than across result rows; combined points still sum all result points for those names.
